rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The party organ reports that at the 13th national convention on the 27th, the representative election being held under rule 17(3) with 山口代表 confirmed as the only candidate, he won the confidence of all delegates present standing and was re-elected ('山口代表が出席代議員の起立総員で信任を得て再任').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It reports that at the convention the re-elected 山口那津男代表 addressed the delegates ('党代表に再任された山口那津男代表は').
